sections.advice: Bludenz → Partenen is 34 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

scenicChapters.title: Silvretta High Alpine Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 31 km this is Silvretta High Alpine Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Silvretta High Alpine Road
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2032 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

silvretta-high-alpine-road.story: Out of Bludenz, one way: 87 km, roughly 1 h 25 in the saddle. On the way it passes Partenen, Bielerhohe and Galtur. The highest point is about 2,300 m. Bielerhohe is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
